direct_answer: The immutable Paper source, revision, and authored-carrier denominators are proven. The current production surface is not RFC email: 3/3 reads returned byte-identical text/html without multipart, plain-text, or mail headers. None of the MIME-dependent cells can pass. The historical CCH28 .eml is a synthetic candidate proxy, not production evidence, and its 50-byte generic plain part is not authored-content parity.

inferences: The stable live HTML probably derives from the pinned source, but it is not self-authenticating because it carries neither Paper id nor revision.
The smallest repair is a real Paper-message construction and evidence boundary around the existing HTML renderer.
Header and containment behavior can change after SMTP, provider, and client rewriting; static preview inspection cannot resolve those risks.
recommended_repair_seams: Build multipart/alternative from the exact revision-pinned source at a Paper-specific RFC message boundary adjacent to BulldocsEmailController and Barkpark.Mailer.
Generate authored-content-equivalent plain text, validated headers, stable Message-ID, and immutable Paper revision headers.
Archive raw submitted and delivered message source plus provider receipt and source digest.
Remove presentation role from authored data tables, add header associations, preserve strong/code semantics, and apply email-safe long-token containment.
Exercise the exact delivered message in real narrow clients; static and synthetic artifacts remain proxies.
risks: No production Paper RFC source, SMTP submission, provider receipt, or delivered-source capture exists.
No authored-content plain-text serializer, CRLF/header-injection test, or real-client long-token proof exists.
Presentation tables, absent header scopes, and style-only marks lose authored semantics.
